question: Does the champion submit path (consensus_w_ctr deltas + dual-moment generation + vcc prep) work end-to-end on a relabeled D/E/F context panel before Oct 22?
baseline_and_intervention: Same code path as k027-consensus-dm; only the contexts flag, context filenames, and a mock 50-target pert_counts.csv differ. No leaderboard submission (plumbing test).

inputs.control_contexts: vcc_2026_controls.zip context_A/B/C.h5ad copied to context_D/E/F.h5ad in data/raw/vcc2026-mock-final/ (throwaway, gitignored)
inputs.mock_panel: first 50 targets of data/raw/vcc2026/pert_counts.csv (panel-order prefix; plumbing only)
inputs.consensus_variant: consensus_w_ctr (local build via tools/build_consensus_deltas.py; jurkat_stim included at default weight 1.0)

axes_and_units.delta_units: mean log1p(raw) perturbed minus control; cd4 source is publisher log2fc, unit-normalized by consensus builder
axes_and_units.generation: build_prediction_dual_moment, integer counts, amplitude=1.0, bulk_amplitude=0.5, pool_k=4, cells_per_target=400, seed=0

scorer_contract: none -- dry-run only; no metrics computed, none recorded here
cost_estimate: local only; ~3 min generation + ~1 min prep dry-run
